points.why: Names shifting the burden to the intervenor and explains the firm met the need yearly while in-house skill lapsed.
Describes the in-house option getting harder each year, making the firm more essential, and warns that waiting worsens it.
Recommends keeping the firm now, having it teach, building an internal core, and running a parallel shadow forecast.
Explicitly says to put the dependency on the risk register by name.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly cautions against dropping the firm abruptly.
Negotiation is one step among several structural fixes aimed at rebuilding capability.
